scheme_name: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Ex‑Serviceman, widow or orphan dependent.
Applicant must hold rank Havildar or equivalent and below.
Scheme is applicable for schooling classes 1‑12 and undergraduate degree courses; widows may also apply for a two‑year post‑graduate degree.
Applicant must not be receiving education allowance or similar benefit from the State or employer.
Eligibility is limited to the first two children, with specific provisions for twins allowing up to three children in certain cases.
The child or widow must successfully complete the course.
In case of death of a child, a death certificate must be uploaded.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of Rs 1000 per month per child (up to two children) and Rs 1000 for widows pursuing a two‑year post‑graduate course.
documents_required: Supporting documents duly attested by the respective Zila Sainik Welfare Officer (ZSWO)
